# Sheet test font

`Unbounded-Bold.ttf` is the exact bold face used by google_fonts 6.3.2:
https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/a/6ace2d8e99cb69f55bfe89ad06fc72389ff796f51abd2806b316694d63083ef7.ttf

Its SHA-256 is `6ace2d8e99cb69f55bfe89ad06fc72389ff796f51abd2806b316694d63083ef7`.
The SIL Open Font License is retained in `OFL.txt` (Google Fonts' Unbounded family).
The widget test asset manifest loads it without network requests. It is not a
pubspec asset and is not bundled in production APKs/IPAs.
